_about: Per-card voice casting for individual minions -- distinct from voice-lines.json, which is keyed by hero PrimaryClass (8 voices, one per class). A legendary or epic minion here can use ANY voice, including one already cast to a hero class (Sam, 2026-09-27): there is no collision rule to check. This file exists to pin the casting decision as it's made, and now the lines dispatched against it.

_moments.play: The minion's ON_PLAY summon beat -- what it says arriving on the board.
_moments.death: Said dying. For Kira Blade of Shadows and Caretaker Solen this coincides with their Toll (ON_DEATH) effect, so the line can lean into what the death itself does.
_moments._wiring: NOT the audio.md event vocabulary (CardPlayed / hero power / friendly-summon-observer). Nothing routes 'attack' or 'death' to a card voice clip yet -- that hookup is separate, later work. This file is content, not wiring.
